civilopediaText.text: Mortals and settlers. They do not fight.
Unpathed Gu Masters of rank one, the clan's base. They choose a path when they reach rank two.
Gu Masters of the moon path. They fight up close, but open every clash with a thrown moon blade.
Gu Masters of the strength path. They hit hardest, and they cost the most to keep.
The beasts of the wild: lightning wolves and their kings. They pillage what they cannot eat.
